rea.purpose: Inspect the installed V380 Pro APK and bundled native libraries to identify the exact camera discovery, authentication, live-stream and SD replay protocol. REA is an investigation tool, not the final app runtime.

candidateAndroidClient.finding: Contains real Android implementation for classic V380 TCP authentication, live media, recording listing and replay/export, with embedded WebView UI. SD playback includes firmware-specific 2016 TFV2 assumptions, including play-mode byte 2 and a 400-packet chunk limit. These assumptions are not established for this owner's camera.
candidateAndroidClient.buildRequirements: .NET 10 SDK, Android workload and SDK, JDK 17

referenceCautions: Public V380 projects target different protocol/firmware families. App name alone does not prove compatibility.
RTSP/live video access does not establish historical SD playback.
A custom UI can improve navigation but cannot alone fix limitations in camera media transfer or SD storage.
V380 working while the camera is on a hotspot does not prove traffic is going through a vendor relay; observe the transport before asserting it.
No exact public match for the supplied HsAwSMCD software string was found in the bounded searches.

milestoneReplay.result: Replay START accepted (code 1000) with {sts(epoch ms), pts:0, time_id, rtype}; camera returns encrypted REPLAY_CTRL_RESPONSE with media info. milestoneClip.result: SUCCESS: our own code retrieved an SD recording over the hotspot (no cloud), decrypted it (AES-128-CBC key=sKey[0:16] iv=sKey[16:32] no-pad per-frame), and produced a valid H.264 clip. SPS parses to 2304x2592 matching camera media info. clip-clean.local.h264 plays in VLC.
milestoneClip.pipeline: keyExchange -> recFileList -> replay 197154 {sts,pts=sts+1,frames:200,speed:10,mode:2,video:1,audio:1,rtype} -> media frames 0x38030820 -> AES-CBC per-frame decrypt -> strip 32B header -> Annex-B NALs

milestoneFullClip.frameHeader: 32B: [1]=type(1=I,2=P,4=audio) [2..3]=u16 seq [6..7]=u16 size [10..11]=u16 ms; NAL at offset 32

cameraControlRE.status: DONE (RE): control = 3 generic methods over the existing 8089 session-keyed path. GET_PROPERTIES=197376, SET_PROPERTIES=197378, ACTION=197384, ABILITY=197386. Envelope is the same {id,method_id,chn:1,ts,params} my buildRequest already produces. Properties addressed by DPID=(group<<16)|0x100|idx, actions by DAID=(group<<16)|0x200|idx. GET params {dplist:[dpid...]} -> data.dplist_result[{dpid,value,vs,code}]; SET params {dplist:[{dpid,value,vs?}]}; ACTION params {daid,vsbmp,in}. Per-prop code 1000=ok, 1114=unsupported-on-this-device, 1103/1104=stale session (re-key). Full map in findings + agent report.

cloudModeRE.status: RE DONE. KEY RESULT: the remote path reuses our LAN IoT protocol almost unchanged. Remote vs local differs only in (1) session-key source and (2) a 64-byte relay-forward header (cmd 1200) on OUTBOUND frames; the 16-byte 0x38030818 header + AES-128-CBC(sKey) body + all methods (GET/SET/ACTION 197376/197378/197384, live 197122, replay 197154) are identical inside the tunnel. sKey still = X25519(appSeed, devicePub).
cloudModeRE.hosts: api/account+device-list: https://mapi.av380.net ; dispatch (relay alloc): http://dispatch.av380.net:8001/api/v1/get_stream_server ; key-exch: http://secret.av380.net/v1/app/exch ; bind/online: http://tmpalive.av380.net . Login servers msglogin(t).av380.net:8443; temp acct rapi.av380.net.
cloudModeRE.remoteFlow: login(user/login -> sAccessToken) -> device/binds (get dev_id, p_key=base64 X25519 pub, password, online_stat[101=LAN], pver) -> if online_stat!=101: dispatch(get_stream_server, sign=sha1('dev_id=..&platform=20001&timestamp=..hsdata2022')) -> createRelaySession(access_token+device_id -> {app_trs_ip,app_trs_port,channel_handle,channel_token,uuid}; code 1012=offline) -> [pver>=5: MQTT wake, broker url dynamic] -> TCP connect app_trs_ip:app_trs_port -> forward-attach 1500B [1100][devId][channel_handle][token<=36] -> read 64B expect [1101][..][1000] -> TSK key-exch (method 196872 plaintext {uuid,cS=base64(sha256(appPub))} -> data.pubKC -> sKey) OR http /v1/app/exch using p_key -> drive control/live/replay with our lib, wrapping outbound in the 64B 1200 header.
cloudModeRE.scaffold: v380cloud.mjs created (parent folder): HOSTS, accountLogin, getDeviceList, dispatchRelay, createRelaySession, forwardAttachBuffer, wrapMR/stripMR, tskExchangeOverTunnel, openRemoteSession. Reuses v380lan X25519 + cipher-sectype2. Syntax-checked; primitives unit-smoke-tested (wrapMR 64B header, forwardAttach 1500B). NOT run against live servers yet (needs creds; avoid login lockout).
cloudModeRE.gaps: Remaining after login/bind pinned: (A) MQTT broker host/port/creds + mqExchangePublish wake topic for pver>=5 (dynamic/unknown, biggest remaining unknown for fully-remote). (B) this camera's pver unknown. (C) inbound relay framing asymmetry (stripMR tolerant). (D) createRelaySession exact path/shape (guessed /v1/app/call).
